usedFor: Calendly takes the bookings; ClickUp tracks the tasks. A booking in Calendly can create a task with “Create Task”, and a new ClickUp task can produce a booking link through “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Create Task” in ClickUp
bestTemplate.why: Every booking becomes a task with assignees, status, priority and due date, so meeting prep does not depend on someone remembering.

watchOut: “Create Task” needs a list to put the task in. The reverse direction, “When a new task is created” into “Create Scheduling Link”, fires for every task, so filter to the ones that need a meeting.
